rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is textbook property damage to real property.
claim_summary: Wind event last weekend removed approximately four shingles from the overhang above the back porch; no water intrusion occurred. Estimated repair cost is $400. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will not be covered, but has been routed for official confirmation and adjuster documentation.

case_facts.description: approximately four shingles blown off roof, no water intrusion
